title: cackpass
tagline: A decentralized event ticketing platform with USDC payments on Arc and on-chain proof of purchase.
description:
CACK-pass is a Web2/Web3 hybrid event ticketing platform that lets organizers
create events, sell tickets, and settle revenue in USDC on Arc. We originally
ran on Lisk with a Paystack fiat rail, but Lisk Mainnet is being deprecated, so
we are migrating the whole platform to Arc — an EVM chain where USDC is the
native gas token and Circle-native rails are first-class.

Buyers can pay two ways:
  • Fiat via Flutterwave (card, USSD, bank transfer, mobile money)
  • Native USDC on Arc via Circle App Kit, using a Privy embedded wallet

Every crypto payment is written on-chain by our CackPassArcPayment contract,
which records the payer, amount, reference, event ID, ticket quantity, and
status (Pending → Confirmed → Failed). That gives organizers and attendees a
shared, tamper-proof audit trail for every ticket sale.

Buyers without crypto can buy real USDC with a card through Privy's Fiat
Onramp (NGN / USD / EUR / GBP), delivered to their embedded wallet on Base
Mainnet. Tickets are stored on IPFS, verified by signed QR codes, and emailed
to the customer after purchase — no login required for guest checkout.
how_its_made:
CACK-pass is a Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript app deployed on Vercel.
Auth and embedded wallets come from Privy — users sign in with email, Google,
or Twitter and get a wallet with no seed phrase to manage.

Payments — Fiat: We migrated the old Paystack rail to Flutterwave v3. The
Flutterwave verify and webhook routes validate `verif-hash` signatures, create
Order + Payment + MyTicket records in MongoDB, and trigger a shared ticket
email. Card, USSD, bank transfer, and mobile money are all supported.

Payments — Crypto (the hackathon core):
  • Contracts: A new Hardhat project (`arc-contracts/`) holds
    `CackPassArcPayment.sol`, deployed and verified on Arc Testnet
    (0x084622e6970BBcBA510454C6145313c2993ED9E4). It exposes
    initializePayment / confirmPayment / failPayment and emits
    PaymentInitiated / PaymentConfirmed / PaymentFailed events.

  • Server side: `lib/arc/client.ts` wraps the contract with ethers v6 —
    provider, signer, generatePaymentId, paymentIdToBytes32,
    initializeOnChainPayment, confirmOnChainPayment, and getOnChainPayment
    (with proper PaymentStatus enum decoding).

  • Client side: `lib/arc/app-kit.ts` wraps Circle App Kit —
    sendUSDCWithAppKit(provider, contractAddress, amount) uses the Privy
    embedded wallet's EIP-1193 provider to move USDC on Arc. Ticket price
    and gas are both paid in USDC because USDC is the native gas token.

  • UX: `components/payments/ArcPaymentButton.tsx` orchestrates it —
    gets the Privy provider, calls /api/payments/arc/initialize,
    invokes sendUSDCWithAppKit, then redirects to
    /payment/success?provider=arc&transaction_id=<hash>. Includes
    double-click guards, wallet-not-ready state, and insufficient-funds
    messaging.

  • Verification: /api/payments/arc/verify polls the contract, calls
    confirmPayment as the platform owner, retries until the status is
    Confirmed, mints MyTicket records, and sends the ticket email via
    a shared /api/email/ticket-confirmation endpoint.

  • Fiat → Crypto onramp: The wallet dashboard uses Privy's
    useFiatOnramp().fund() to buy real USDC with a card (NGN / USD / EUR /
    GBP) on Base Mainnet. Base and Arc balances are shown side by side in
    a dual-network dashboard so buyers can see exactly where their funds
    live.

Partner tech benefits:
  • Arc — native USDC gas means zero-gas UX for buyers.
  • Circle App Kit — the fastest way to move USDC into a contract-driven
    payment flow.
  • Privy — passwordless auth + embedded wallets + fiat onramp in one SDK.
  • Flutterwave — reliable African fiat rails (card, USSD, bank, mobile money).

Hacky bits worth mentioning: We solved a Mongoose strict-mode gotcha by
resolving the buyer email from multiple fallbacks (Order → Payment →
metadata.userEmail → User) so ticket emails never get dropped. We also
made the Arc verify step idempotent — if a payment is marked completed but
no ticket exists, we self-heal and re-process instead of silently failing.
auto_summary: A Next.js ticketing platform that sells event tickets via fiat and USDC payments, with Arc contract-based payment records and email ticket delivery.
